decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost complement to the established floor-care range. It is still young enough that weak sales can be read as temporary. Dropping Product B already trimmed the care range, so management has little reason to cut further.
With the maintenance oil gone, this multi-model care line now carries the firm's commitment to oiled-floor maintenance. Sunk costs and strategic fit argue for keeping it.
The moisture-protection underlay is a natural accessory to the flooring systems the firm sells. Slow uptake can still be attributed to the market-entry phase.
The high-density underlay completes the accessory portfolio the firm has publicly presented. Management will persist despite some overlap with the other underlay.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's production investment and announced direction, so withdrawing it is very unlikely.
